summary: In this excerpt from Book 10, the narrator Jap writes to his mother about his new job in Operations 1 on the top floor of the File-O-Gator organization. He describes his supervisor Rhindquist, who asks odd questions, praises his loyalty and recounts the Basic Training, Vision Statement and Anthill Simulator lessons, then gives him a raise. The two watch old movies together each afternoon, including Educating Rita, which Rhindquist compares to the narrator. The note ends with the narrator seeing his roommate Tony, who also works in Operations 1 in the basement and looked worried.
one_line: Jap writes his mother about his promotion-driven job in File-O-Gator's Operations 1, his supervisor Rhindquist, and his worried roommate Tony.
key_facts: Jap works in a beautiful office on the top floor of Operations 1, one hundred floors above ground.
Rhindquist sits in the chair by the door of Jap's office and talks on his phone while asking him unusual questions.
Rhindquist asks whether Jap thinks the pinheads in HR know their ass from a hole in the ground, and Jap answers Yes.
Jap memorized the File-O-Gator Vision Statement during Basic Training.
The Vision Statement describes The File-O-Gator Organization as a diverse multinational sovereign power that is a World-Class Leader in its fields of Operations.
Jap played the Anthill Simulator and learned that the one drone doesn't know why he's moving a grain of sand, but from the Queen's seat it all makes sense.
Rhindquist calls Jap his bright boy and a walking focus-group, and says he is not paying Jap enough.
Rhindquist calls someone on his phone, says Give my boy a raise, and Jap receives a raise.
Jap is sending home a little money as an attachment with the note, along with a picture of himself in his Special Vice-President's suit.
Each afternoon Rhindquist shuts off his phone and Jap's watch, and a pretty secretary wheels in a big TV for movies.
Rhindquist knows most of the old funny movies by heart.
The movie Educating Rita is about a dumb girl from England, Ltd., who works as a hairdresser until someone from management teaches her about life.
Jap's roommate Tony is described as crazy and was seen covering up all the plugs.
Tony also works in Operations 1, in the basement, and was seen getting off the slidewalk and heading to the basement elevators looking worried.
